description: Build an ACAP3 BAR dimer model on the ACAP1 BAR-PH crystal (4NSW) and compare the charge of the concave membrane-facing surface
code:
import numpy as np, json, matplotlib
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
AA3={'ALA':'A','ARG':'R','ASN':'N','ASP':'D','CYS':'C','GLN':'Q','GLU':'E','GLY':'G','HIS':'H',
 'ILE':'I','LEU':'L','LYS':'K','MET':'M','MSE':'M','PHE':'F','PRO':'P','SER':'S','THR':'T',
 'TRP':'W','TYR':'Y','VAL':'V'}
def read_res(fn, chain=None, lo=None, hi=None, sidechain_centroid=True):
    """return list of dict(num,ch,aa,ca,sc)"""
    acc={}
    for l in open(fn):
        if not l.startswith("ATOM"): continue
        if l[16] not in (' ','A'): continue
        rn=l[17:20].strip()
        if rn not in AA3: continue
        c=l[21]; num=int(l[22:26])
        if chain and c!=chain: continue
        if lo is not None and not (lo<=num<=hi): continue
        xyz=np.array([float(l[30:38]),float(l[38:46]),float(l[46:54])])
        nm=l[12:16].strip()
        d=acc.setdefault((c,num),{'num':num,'ch':c,'aa':AA3[rn],'ca':None,'sc':[]})
        if nm=="CA": d['ca']=xyz
        if nm not in ("N","CA","C","O"): d['sc'].append(xyz)
    out=[]
    for k,d in acc.items():
        if d['ca'] is None: continue
        d['sc']=np.mean(d['sc'],axis=0) if d['sc'] else d['ca']
        out.append(d)
    return sorted(out,key=lambda d:(d['ch'],d['num']))

def kabsch(P,Q):
    pc=P.mean(0); qc=Q.mean(0)
    U,S,Vt=np.linalg.svd((P-pc).T@(Q-qc))
    D=np.diag([1,1,np.sign(np.linalg.det(Vt.T@U.T))]); R=Vt.T@D@U.T
    return R, qc-R@pc

# ACAP1 BAR dimer from 4NSW (BAR only, res 1-230)
bar1=[r for r in read_res("4NSW.pdb") if 1<=r['num']<=230]
# ACAP3 AF BAR monomer
bar3m=read_res("AF_ACAP3.pdb",chain="A",lo=1,hi=230)

# sequence-align ACAP3 BAR to ACAP1 BAR by simple offset (both start at 1, ~55% id) -> use CA of common numbers
def superpose_by_number(mov,ref):
    rn={r['num']:r for r in ref}
    pairs=[(m,rn[m['num']]) for m in mov if m['num'] in rn]
    P=np.array([p[0]['ca'] for p in pairs]); Q=np.array([p[1]['ca'] for p in pairs])
    R,t=kabsch(P,Q)
    rms=np.sqrt(((((R@P.T).T+t)-Q)**2).sum(1).mean())
    return R,t,rms,len(pairs)

model3=[]
for cid in ("A","B"):
    ref=[r for r in bar1 if r['ch']==cid]
    R,t,rms,n=superpose_by_number(bar3m,ref)
    print(f"ACAP3 BAR -> ACAP1 4NSW chain {cid}: {n} CA pairs, RMSD {rms:.2f} A")
    for r in bar3m:
        model3.append({'num':r['num'],'ch':cid,'aa':r['aa'],
                       'ca':R@r['ca']+t,'sc':R@r['sc']+t})

def concave_profile(res, label):
    X=np.array([r['sc'] for r in res]); C=X.mean(0)
    Y=X-C
    U,S,Vt=np.linalg.svd(Y,full_matrices=False)
    pc=Y@Vt.T              # pc[:,0] long axis, pc[:,1], pc[:,2]
    # find which of PC2/PC3 carries the crescent curvature vs PC1
    best=None
    for k in (1,2):
        co=np.polyfit(pc[:,0],pc[:,k],2)
        if best is None or abs(co[0])>abs(best[1][0]): best=(k,co)
    k,co=best
    sign=np.sign(co[0])             # curvature opens toward +sign
    concave=sign*pc[:,k]            # larger = concave (inner) face
    resid=pc[:,k]-np.polyval(co,pc[:,0])
    conc_dev=sign*resid             # deviation from the arc, positive = concave side
    q=np.array([1 if r['aa'] in 'KR' else (-1 if r['aa'] in 'DE' else 0) for r in res])
    thr=np.percentile(conc_dev,70)
    face=conc_dev>=thr
    nb=int((q[face]==1).sum()); na=int((q[face]==-1).sum())
    print(f"{label}: BAR dimer n={len(res)}  concave face (top 30% by arc deviation, n={face.sum()}): "
          f"K/R={nb}  D/E={na}  net={nb-na:+d}; whole BAR net={int(q.sum()):+d}")
    return pc, conc_dev, q, face, (nb,na,int(q.sum()))

print()
pc1,cd1,q1,f1,st1=concave_profile(bar1,"ACAP1 BAR dimer (4NSW crystal)")
pc3,cd3,q3,f3,st3=concave_profile(model3,"ACAP3 BAR dimer (AF model on 4NSW)")

fig,axes=plt.subplots(1,2,figsize=(13,5.2),sharey=True)
for ax,pc,cd,q,lab in [(axes[0],pc1,cd1,q1,"ACAP1 BAR dimer (4NSW, crystal)"),
                       (axes[1],pc3,cd3,q3,"ACAP3 BAR dimer (AlphaFold on 4NSW)")]:
    col=np.where(q==1,"#2166ac",np.where(q==-1,"#b2182b","#cccccc"))
    ax.scatter(pc[:,0],np.sign(1)*cd,c=col,s=26,edgecolor='none')
    ax.axhline(0,color='k',lw=0.6)
    ax.set_xlabel("position along BAR long axis (A)")
    ax.set_title(lab,fontsize=11)
axes[0].set_ylabel("deviation from crescent arc (A)\npositive = concave face")
from matplotlib.lines import Line2D
axes[1].legend(handles=[Line2D([],[],marker='o',ls='',color="#2166ac",label="Lys/Arg"),
                        Line2D([],[],marker='o',ls='',color="#b2182b",label="Asp/Glu"),
                        Line2D([],[],marker='o',ls='',color="#cccccc",label="other")],
               loc="lower right",frameon=False)
fig.suptitle("Charge distribution on the BAR concave (membrane-facing) surface",y=0.99)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
json.dump({"ACAP1":st1,"ACAP3":st3},open("bar_concave_charge.json","w"))
